restoring-equilibrium.title: The spring pulls toward zero
restoring-equilibrium.caption: A positive stretch gives a negative force. At +0.020 m the force is −1 N.

amplitude-phase.title: Start at the right-hand end
amplitude-phase.caption: The curve starts at +0.10 m and first crosses zero at about 0.157 s. Its largest distance from zero stays 0.10 m.

viscous-oscillator.title: The limit on the swings shrinks
viscous-oscillator.caption: These curves show the upper and lower envelope, not the object’s exact position. At 5 s the limit is about ±0.0368 m.

travelling-profile.title: Track one moving crest
travelling-profile.caption: The same crest moves from 0.40 m to 1.00 m in 0.20 s. This is a graph of the crest’s position over time.

standing-superposition.title: Fixed nodes in a standing wave
standing-superposition.caption: Two opposite extreme shapes share zeros at 0, 0.40 and 0.80 m. The point at 0.20 m reaches ±3 mm. These are snapshots, not travelling paths.

string-mode-expansion.title: Two patterns make one starting shape
string-mode-expansion.caption: The first pattern contributes 3 mm at the centre; the second contributes zero there. The solid line adds their displacements at every point.

beat-envelope.title: Loudness peaks repeat
beat-envelope.caption: This shows the amplitude envelope of the equal 120 Hz and 126 Hz tones, relative to the largest combined amplitude. It reaches a peak every 1/6 s; the fast sound waves are not drawn.

localized-packet.title: A pulse occupies one interval
localized-packet.caption: The model is 3 V between −0.50 and +0.50 m, and zero outside. Its rectangular area is 3 V·m.

dispersion-relation.title: Frequency follows a curved rule
dispersion-relation.caption: At wave number 5 rad/m, the angular frequency is 10 rad/s. A curve means the ratio of the two values is not constant.

phase-group-speed.title: A ratio and a slope give different speeds
phase-group-speed.caption: At wave number 5, the point is (5,10). The line from zero to that point has slope 2 m/s; the local dashed line has slope 4 m/s.

packet-spreading.title: The packet’s width grows
packet-spreading.caption: This graph shows width, not the packet’s position. The 0.50 m starting width reaches about 0.707 m after 0.50 s.

cutoff-evanescence.title: The field fades with distance
cutoff-evanescence.caption: The amplitude starts at one boundary-value unit. At 0.50 m it is about 0.135 of that value; this is not a travelling crest.

polarizer-projection.title: Turning the polarizer changes the intensity
polarizer-projection.caption: At 60° the intensity is 20 W/m², one quarter of the starting 80 W/m². The curve describes this ideal polarized input.

two-slit-interference.title: Bright bands are 4 mm apart
two-slit-interference.caption: The peaks repeat every 4 mm. This ideal two-slit timing pattern ignores the width of each slit; height is relative to a bright peak.

single-slit-diffraction.title: The first dark bands sit at ±10 mm
single-slit-diffraction.caption: The central bright region spans 20 mm between its first zeros. Intensity is shown relative to the centre.
